> When bringing an ghoul ally into play (from your library) is the card
> placed face up, face down, or doesn't matter. There seems to be some

Face up. Like a Shock Troop (or any other in-play card).
It may be convenient to turn them face down to avoid
confusion (after showing the card to all players), but if any
player wants to know which card it is, she's free to look.

we went with 'upside down', rather than face-down.
ie: the title is on the edge closest to you.

avoids confusion if you have a bunch of contestion around. 2 life
counters help to distinguish them, too. (and only a little bit
confusing when tapped, provided you always tap your cards to the same
side)

However, as a call to Steve Weick, etc, can we get Absimilard cards
like the corruption and anarch marker cards? then we could just remove
the top card of our library from play and put an AA Ghoul card in play
instead. I'm planning on making up some for myself, but real ones
would be much cooler.
